    External MCP Server Catalog - Sweep Log¶

    Every discovery pass behind the external MCP server catalog, newest first. Each entry records what the mcpservers.org and mcp.so surfaces returned, which candidates were measured, and what was held and why.

    🆕 November 18, 2026 - Evening Sweep (1 New, 1 Guide)¶

    Fired on the 21:00 MST tick, ten hours after the midday supplement closed. The directory produced its largest raw rise of the week and it was an ingestion wave rather than a burst of products: 326 new <loc> entries, 280 new keys, and neither number survives as a count of products once the fleets and the mirrors are named. The feed carried five consumer cards. The submission queue carried twenty-five arrivals, and one of them is the only server this pass could drive end to end without a customer account.

    • Contha MCP - Small-Business Books Read by an Agent - remote Streamable HTTP, keyless demo at https://demo.contha.com/api/mcp and OAuth on https://app.contha.com/api/mcp, contha-demo 0.4.0 on protocol 2025-06-18, 22 tools listed and fourteen driven. The two-book split is the product: a sole proprietor's personal card and business account live in one set of books, and audit_misfiled_business exists to find the charges that landed on the wrong side, returning five findings totalling $115.98 (one OfficeMax charge at $55.98, four Figma charges at $15.00) each with a null category and the matched vendor named. The arithmetic closes to the cent where it can be checked: free-to-use $40,380.70 from cash $45,509.84 less cards $1,878.27, goals set aside $1,595.50, bills due in thirty days $296.38 and tax due $1,358.99; the 2026 Schedule C carries $71,500.00 of receipts and $11,213.65 of expenses over four lines that sum exactly (car and truck $91.20, contract labor $7,258.99, office $166.32, other $3,697.14) for tentative profit $60,286.35; self-employment tax reproduces at $8,518.19 on $55,674.44 of taxable earnings with Social Security at $6,903.63 and Medicare at $1,614.56. Three readings recorded rather than reconciled: the headline tax figure of $1,358.99 appears in both get_overview and get_tax_estimate and does not reproduce from the fields beside it (balance due −$1,668.32, projected full-year $16,791.48 less $16,200.00 paid at $591.48, all four installments at toPay 0); get_budget's leftToSpend of $1,869.27 pools $1,050.00 of carried-in budget that reads as a $1,050.00 error against planned − spent; and the demo exposes no write tool at all, so add_cash_transaction returns Unknown tool while the production service's six write tools file transactions and maintain rules, budgets, bills and goals, and by the vendor's own statement never move money. Production OAuth is complete on a single host: protected-resource document with read and write scopes, authorization-server document with PKCE S256 and open dynamic registration.

    Also identified this pass (not catalogued). Held with the gate or class named: Querya (#7624), 59 Google Ads tools with Keyword Planner forecasting, validated change previews and undo, is the strongest hold, gated by 401 with scope="ads.read" and covered by AdRails, AdsCove and the AdKit fleet on a differentiator AdRails was catalogued on; Spica Post (#7628) on social scheduling behind a studio scope; DirectCase (#7614) on the legal trio (LEGAION, aka-recht, Specter Cite); gaents (#7629), keyless over 14 marketplace tools, on the agent-marketplace and x402 rail classes; Search402 (#7625) on x402 search; volatiai (#7607), already dispositioned on November 13; Stopover (#7617) and Seatac Co (#7611) as one travel vertical each; Better Llama (#7616) on the donniertf open-data expansion; thunderbirdmcp (#7615), 56 tools, on the inbox class and the local-profile install gate; Voicedex (#7608) on voice pricing; OpenLandscape (#7612) outside operator scope; x402 Tool Shop (#7613) on the x402 class with its OFAC leg noted; vbtnl (#7619), Sempera (#7618), Importly (#7620), SignOff Studio (#7609), Osmanth (#7610), AimYear (#7605), LeadWebia (#7606), CT (#7626), iphone-mcp (#7623), ShortSpec (#7622) and Rephrase AI (#7621) as single-vendor or utility surfaces. On the wave: 50 cotlet-dev-integrations-* slugs as one vendor fleet, 9 Apify actors on the standing hold, 23 documentation mirrors, 14 agents pages, 3 llms.txt pages, 4 API pages and 5 developers pages by class, paceads, misiki-in/gocommerce and the mambalabsdev five as prior or class holds, alertviz-com-eurokyb on the company-data class, the two antevo-ch-* slugs continuing the November 4 fleet disposition, and lumman-co-mcp-multi-books and xmevans10/dealhound recorded as endpoints that refused a keyless handshake rather than as products. The feed's five cards above the cutoff (shiftlog-it, moodlight, spooky-particles, wals-pro-ai-4-weclapp, openshorts-io) were all held on consumer or media classes. /all was not re-read: 403 by edge policy, the standing condition since 4 November.

    🆕 November 18, 2026 - Midday Supplement (1 New, 1 Guide)¶

    Fired on the 11:00 MST tick, one hour after the midday sweep closed. Both directory surfaces came back flat by measurement rather than assertion, and the whole of the window was five queue arrivals, of which one held a surface worth a guide.

    • Hail MCP - A Phone Number and an Inbox for an Agent - hosted at https://mcp.hail.so on the root path with no /mcp suffix, hail 0.1.3 on protocol 2025-06-18, 46 tools listed keyless of which 27 are read-only, 12 write and 7 destructive. The safety envelope is a parameter, not a promise: place_call, send_sms and send_email require recipient_consent as the JSON boolean true (the vendor says "true" and 1 are refused before a request leaves), acquire_number compares confirm_total_cents against the live quote and fails 409 having charged nothing when they disagree, quotes expire in 10 minutes, and both release_number and delete_agent need a typed confirmation. Four tool counts on one product, one of them live: the docs prose says 36, its own table lists 38, the marketing page says 37, and the live tools/list serves 46 - the eight missing from the table include create_file_upload, which hands an agent a one-time upload link for a shell. tools/call answers 401 with resource_metadata pointing at a complete protected-resource document, and the issuer's RFC 8414 document lives on the other host at hail.so/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/api/auth while the same route 404s on the MCP host. The family that decides the integration is carrier verification: requirements, a dry run that files nothing, submission under attest_authorized, polling for approved or a named rejection reason, and a code confirmation, with the file limits stated up front (10 MiB each, 29 MiB total, 20 files and 20 fields). Published pricing is prepaid rather than a subscription, $0.10 a minute for US and Canada voice against $0.149 for the same four parts billed separately, $0.018 / 0.035 / 0.20 per text by destination, $1 per 1,000 emails, and a dedicated number from $0.50 a month at carrier price.

    Also identified this pass (not catalogued). Held with the gate or class named: Realtimer (#7600, ai.realtimer/calls), a read-only call-transcript server whose protected-resource document and calls:read scope are complete but whose surface cannot be measured because it needs a Realtimer Pro account and a Mac app, the same gate that held Highseat at the midday sweep; Wellnizz (#7601, com.wellnizz/health), 34 tools over lab results, DNA files and wearables, a consumer health vertical beside the metri and Verateca holds; Llamly (#7602, com.llamly/wordpress), a WordPress plugin that turns a site into an MCP server with a change journal and undo, held because the drive path needs a live WordPress install and the WordPress content class is already carried by Elementor and miniOrange; and worklore (#7603), four of ten tools driven keyless over a 269-story library with a T0 to T4 capability x-ray that returned T4 and named remote-exec at line 2 on a deliberate test input, held as a developer-story library whose scanning role sits beside the prompt-injection class already carried by GLC PromptGuard and Poison Armor. /all was not re-read: 403 by edge policy, the standing condition since 4 November.

    🆕 November 18, 2026 - Midday Sweep (3 New, 3 Guides)¶

    Fired on the 10:00 MST tick, six and a half hours after the night sweep closed. The canonical moved by four raw entries and zero keys, the feed carried five server cards and none of them survived a class check, and all three ships came from the submission queue.

    • Global Shopaholics MCP - Landed Cost From a US Address - keyless at https://mcp.globalshopaholics.com/mcp, global-shopaholics 1.0.0 on protocol 2025-06-18, seven tools of which five were driven, the two request_* tools left undriven because both open a human intake. The duty rule is the product: a $400 German order returns an assisted-purchase fee of 20.00 on a stated 5%-with-$5-minimum basis, a duty and tax band of 79.80 to 139.78, and the rule behind it - 19% VAT, no VAT threshold, the €150 duty-free threshold abolished 1 July 2026 and replaced by a €3 per-category charge expiring 1 July 2028; the UAE returns 5% VAT and a Dubai-only exemption under AED 1,000 from 3 August 2026. Live rates too: Nigeria 5 kg returns FedEx Intl. Connect Plus at $174.68 in 7 to 10 days with a resolved delivery date, and a bad country code refuses by name with the public calculator as the recovery path. One trap measured: a top-level weight is silently discarded because the argument belongs inside a package object, and the UAE total then reads 275.63 to 289.41 against 326.63 to 342.96 for the same order - fifty-one dollars, with the wrong answer looking finished.

The search takes a decision, not keywords: a checkout test with interference between arms returned 104 full matches from 365 candidates, a short-history forecasting question 52 from 306, both under the same snapshot so the corpus is versioned. The cards carry the mechanism rather than the headline - Lyft on why rider-level randomisation breaks when riders and drivers share one supply pool, and the remedy it names (fit the randomisation unit to the interference, then pre-register, correct with Benjamini-Hochberg, log the decision); Apple on why a per-session metric understates variance when the randomisation unit is the user. Each card declares whether its original is fetchable, marking Lyft bot-blocked and Apple open. One defect: an unknown slug returns HTTP 200 with isError false and the error inline per card, so a client rendering only the content block shows an empty answer as a result.

    • MeiSIM MCP - Phone Lines an Agent Can Own - hosted Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.meisimusa.com/mcp, keyless handshake as meisimusa-mcp 0.3.5 on protocol 2025-06-18, sixteen tools of which six answered with live data and six returned the server's own 401. The product is a real US mobile line, not a VoIP number: get_ai_line_offer priced it at 35 dollars a month per line for texts and 45 with SIP voice, falling to 32 and 42 at 10 lines, 29 and 39 at 50 and 25 and 35 at 200, on a two month minimum paid up front, with no refunds once a number is delivered. search_us_numbers returned 28 prepaid plans across five carriers from 7.50 to 288, every row carrying includes_us_number, and the price ceiling held at both bounds tested (10 returned two plans topping out at 10.00, 25 returned nine topping out at 21.00). search_plans returned 58 Japan, 80 France and 86 US eSIM plans from eight suppliers (Airalo, Sparks, 3, Bouygues, NextLink, RoamVault, IIJ, MeiSIM), cheapest 5.99, 4.70 and 5.99, and an empty list with no error for a country with no coverage. get_quote totalled 7.50 with zero tax and fees and expired in exactly 15 minutes, measured twice. wait_for_message blocks up to 50 seconds for the next inbound text, which is the tool a verification flow actually needs. The access model is the finding: every account tool answers a 401 that names both routes in and then states that a person opens the account, an AI agent cannot open the account by itself, behind a robot check and a government ID, so the agent buys, provisions, reads and replies while a human passes identity. Three defects recorded rather than smoothed: purchase requires a payment_method object whose own description says it is not used, search_plans refuses a call that omits duration_days while presenting data_gb as the optional filter, and a purchase mis-call returns two validation failures concatenated into one message with no field separator. First entry here for a phone line an agent owns, beside Mobile Text Alerts for broadcast SMS and WhatsApp Business for the Meta messaging platform.

    • NYSgpt Data Library MCP - SQL Over Public Records - remote Streamable HTTP at https://data.nysgpt.com/mcp, keyless to a daily limit, server nysgpt-data-library 2.0 on protocol 2025-06-18, registry com.nysgpt/data-library 2.0.0, four tools all four driven over nine tools/call requests. The catalogue is measured, not repeated: list_databases returned 36 databases and list_tables on govblock_patents returned 128 tables whose stated row counts sum to 3,055,846,513, led by patex_transactions_25 at 504,754,561, patex_attorney_agent_25 at 366,993,004 and pv_g_us_patent_citation at 152,631,929. A query and its own arithmetic: hist_annual reported 175 rows and 147 fields, all typed string with no descriptions, and a four-row read returned 2014 at 412,861 applications and 2,565,874 patents in force, 2013 at 402,538, 2012 at 381,508 and 2011 at 357,132, with bytes_scanned 1,400 and a query_id on the answer; the newest year is 2014 and the table holds 175 rows, which is exactly 1840 to 2014, so a caller asking for the current year must go to the patex_* tables instead.     Fired on the 03:00 MST tick, six hours after the evening sweep's read. The two surfaces disagreed and both readings are recorded: mcpservers.org was flat to the entry count, every one of its twelve server maps carrying exactly the URL count it carried at 21:00 MST, while the mcp.so feed delivered one scheduled batch of eight cards all stamped 2026-11-11T08:00Z. Three of those eight earned guides, and all three are local-first tools that were installed and driven on this host rather than described from a README: an email archive converter, a security scanner for agent-written code, and a memory server whose statements can be corrected without being deleted.

    • dead-letter MCP - Email Archives an Agent Can Actually Read - local stdio, uvx --python 3.12 --from "dead-letter[mcp]" dead-letter-mcp, registry record io.github.BigCactusLabs/dead-letter 0.4.10, protocol 2025-06-18. tools/list returned exactly five tools (convert_eml, convert_eml_to_bundle, convert_directory, convert_mbox, get_diagnostics) with get_diagnostics the only one annotated readOnlyHint: true, and resources/list plus prompts/list returned zero entries although both capabilities are advertised. A crafted message with a duplicated plain-text part, an HTML signature table, a tracking pixel and In-Reply-To headers converted to 465 bytes of Markdown: one body rather than two, the signature preserved as a Markdown table, the date normalised to ISO 8601 UTC from a -0500 header, and the tracking pixel kept by default until --strip-tracking-pixels was passed. --strip-signatures did not remove the table-shaped signature, which is the measured limit of a delimiter heuristic. The licence is the first decision, not the last: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, "any noncommercial purpose is a permitted purpose", no commercial licence published, so an internal company pipeline sits outside the grant. The vendor's own benchmark is labelled as such: roughly 88 percent fewer tokens than raw .eml across an 11-message synthetic set, with the attachment category median about 126,000 tokens raw against 180 converted, and the README says plainly that naive extractors are cheaper because they discard metadata. There is no mailbox connection: it converts files you already exported, and the CLI accepts .zip and .tgz where the MCP tools do not.
    • Vibe Shield MCP - The Security Scan Before an Agent Says Done - npm CLI plus MCP server, zero runtime dependencies, MIT, @vibefoundry/vibe-shield 2.1.2, registry io.github.avivgerz-hue/vibe-shield 2.1.2, repository created 2026-11-07 with 26 stars. On a crafted Next.js App Router route with four planted defects it returned GRADE F, 0/100, 5 critical in 26 ms over 80 active rules: three unguarded mutation routes (VSB-AUTH-001 twice), one concatenated SQL statement (VSB-DB-007), one record owner taken from the request body (VSB-AUTH-004), and one hardcoded credential (VSB-SECRET-001) that the report redacted as sk_liv•••• rather than reprinting it. Exit codes were measured four ways: plain scan 1, --fail-on critical 1, --format json 1, and a clean control file GRADE A+ 0. The JSON report carries schemaVersion, attackSurface, per-finding cwe, owasp, confidence and a remediation object with an insecure and a secure example, and the score object states its own cap: {"ceiling":{"severity":"critical","limit":29}}, so a single critical pins the maximum at 29, which is why the agent-surface audit reported GRADE F, 29/100. That audit is the second command and the honest half of this entry: on a poisoned SKILL.md it caught the exfiltration (VSB-AGENT-002, a curl posting env to a remote host) and the missing manifest scope (VSB-AGENT-010) across 12 rules, and flagged neither "ignore all previous instructions" nor "never mention this section", so it detects what an instruction does, not what it asks a reader to hide. The vendor states its own limit on the demo: "a clean score is not a security guarantee."
    • CtxVault MCP - Memory You Correct Instead of Overwrite - local stdio server and CLI over the same vaults, MIT, package 0.9.1 on PyPI while initialize reports ctxvault 1.30.0, registry io.github.Filippo-Venturini/ctxvault 0.9.1, 62 stars, protocol 2025-06-18. Memory is split into three vault types: semantic documents read by meaning, skill procedures read by name, and episodic statements holding two timelines, valid_from/valid_to in the world and known_at in the vault. tools/list returned 17 tools, more than the eleven the README names, and the episodic set is the design: write_episode, query_episodes (with valid_at, known_at and include_closed), supersede_episode, invalidate_episode, revise_episode, confirm_episode, dispute_episodes, episode_history and list_entities. The lifecycle was run on a throwaway vault: two statements about one customer, one from an invoice and one from a contract amendment, both stayed open, which is the first thing to know because an append corrects nothing by itself; supersede then closed the first at the exact microsecond the replacement opened, kept its source, recorded superseded by pointing at the new record, and deleted nothing. dispute leaves two contradictory statements open rather than picking a winner, which is closer to how an operator treats two sources that disagree. Storage is measured, not inferred: one directory per vault holding one episodes.db, with restricted and allowed_agents in the config, so isolation is a filesystem boundary. The cost is measured too: uv tool install ctxvault occupies 5.9 GB because sentence-transformers and chromadb are hard dependencies that resolve PyTorch and the CUDA runtime wheels on Linux, and an episodic vault builds no vectors unless an embedding model is named at init. Not first of class here, but the first entry where the correction itself is a tool with a closing timestamp.

    🆕 November 9, 2026 - Night Sweep (2 New, 2 Guides)¶

    Fired on the 03:00 MST tick, six hours after the evening sweep. Both directory surfaces came back flat, so the whole window is sixteen submissions from #6970 to #6985, all arrivals, plus one fresh feed card. Two are catalogued and both are the same pattern from the same publisher: one published government file reshaped into a ranked list around a ZIP, for one trade with a purchase behind it.

    • newlyraised MCP - SEC Form D and SBA Raise Leads - remote Streamable HTTP at https://app.newlyraised.com/mcp, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, DCR and Client ID Metadata Documents, registry com.newlyraised/newlyraised 1.0.0, submission #6975, 5 read-only tools over six US metros (Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, San Antonio, Denver, Atlanta). The tools are list_metros, new_raises, sba_loans, lender_activity and get_record, and every row carries the public source link plus the matching view in the web app. The freshness is stated by the vendor rather than left to inference: a Form D daily index covering November 2 to 6 fetched the morning of November 7, an SBA file dated October 30 carrying approvals through September 30 with the next one expected around the end of January 2027, and static Census files placing each record in a metro. The class neighbours are adjacent and none overlaps - Mamba Funding Investor Record is a 32-field record lookup for one named company, AllClear Lending works the borrower's side of commercial credit, and SpendQuery covers federal awards. This is the acquisition side of the SBA file read as a market: who bought a business, which lender financed it, and which advisory firm is one call from the new owner.
    • StandbyBrief MCP - CMS Citation Leads for Contractors - remote Streamable HTTP, registry com.standbybrief/standbybrief 1.0.0, submission #6972, 6 tools over CMS's nursing-home fire-safety inspection file, 14-day trial from the consent screen with no card. A keyless initialize on the app host answers 401 with a protected-resource pointer and the scope standbybrief. The design decision is that three citation tags map to three trades with a purchase behind each one: K918 for emergency power, which is the generator dealer, and K353 and K345 for sprinklers and fire alarms, which are the two contractors, with the correction date on the row being the reason it is a sales instrument rather than a report. Every row carries CMS's wording, survey date, scope and severity, correction status and date, distance and the CMS record link, and get_data_freshness, explain_citation_tag, get_export_links and get_account_status cover the questions a person asks before working from the list. One routing gap is measured rather than assumed: the published apex /mcp route carried the parent company's website at the time of this pass while app.standbybrief.com/mcp answered the handshake, so the guide documents the route that answers and states the gap.

    🆕 November 8, 2026 - Evening Sweep (6 New, 6 Guides)¶

    Fired on the 21:00 MST tick, ten hours after the midday supplement, and the window was the largest of the day: 186 sitemap additions after two identical passes, 24 queue issues, and a scheduled bulk publish stamped four hours ahead of the clock. Six servers are catalogued, each on evidence rather than on a card. The wave itself decomposes once rather than one at a time: 19 Cotlet per-app connectors become one entry, 47 documentation-route slugs hold on the November 1 ruling, 12 BumiAtlas land-record datasets and 12 MambaLabs creator tools hold as single-publisher families, 8 x402 worker artifacts hold as worker artifacts, 3 MCPKit-RU Yandex tools hold on geography, and the 85 individual slugs were resolved through the official registry rather than guessed from domain-shaped names.

    • Vericto MCP - SQL Guardrails Before the Query Runs - remote Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.vericto.com/mcp, an OAuth account surface at /mcp/account, and a self-hosted proxy at docker run vericto/vericto-proxy:5.0.0 mcp, registry records com.vericto/mcp, com.vericto/vericto-proxy and com.vericto/account, filed as three submissions in the same second. A keyless initialize answers 401 naming the header it wants, so the tier is documented and gated rather than driven. This is the first entry here that decides about a statement before it runs. Rules are written on the parsed syntax tree rather than on query text, so a comment or a subquery cannot walk around them; columns are masked in the result; each agent gets its own table and column allowlist; a rule simulator tests a change against real traffic; policies roll out observe-before-enforce with a kill switch; and every decision lands in an audit trail with signed reports. The AGPL-3.0 proxy states its own behaviour and is the reason to trust the free tier: with no account it applies the built-in rules for destructive statements, a missing WHERE, risky DDL and data exposure, reports nothing anywhere, and runs every statement in a read-only transaction that ends in ROLLBACK, executing exactly what it checked. The same engine fails a deploy (vericto check migrations/*.sql returns BLOCKED VERICTO-001 DELETE without WHERE with a suggested fix). The class neighbour is DutyKit on the compliance side, and the distinction is that read-only access is a property of a credential while this is a policy with a receipt.
    • frag.hugo MCP - German GDPR Duties on a Calendar - remote Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.fraghugo.de/mcp, registry de.fraghugo/frag.hugo, submission #6957, 14 tools on a keyless tools/list and OAuth for the 42 account tools. Driven live twice. search_gdpr_fines returned 101 cases with the newest three: Xandr, a Microsoft company, EUR 8,600,000 from Datatilsynet for real-time bidding data that allowed inference about sexual orientation, IQVIA Solutions Italy at EUR 7,000,000 from the Garante, and Google Ireland at EUR 403,000,000 from the DPC, each with the articles, a summary and the regulator's own URL. get_compliance_deadlines returned 18 dated obligations from the day of the call, including the AI Act deepfake prohibition on 2026-12-02 under Art. 5(1)(ba) and (bb), the machine-readable labelling duty for systems already on the market the same day under Art. 50(2), and the product liability change on 2026-12-09 that makes software a product under Directive (EU) 2024/2853. Beyond the calendar: get_subprocessor_changes watches the subprocessor lists of 17 cloud providers, find_supervisory_authority resolves the competent German authority from a postcode, get_cyber_threat_picture counts ransomware leak-site naming by industry, check_email_security reads SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNSSEC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI and CAA, report_data_breach starts the 72-hour Art. 33 clock and create_data_subject_request the one-month Art. 12 deadline. The guardrails are stated by the server: mail and deletion run preview-then-confirm, every change is undoable for 90 days, and what is submitted is reviewed by a data protection officer. ISMS Copilot carries the certification programme and this is the dated reference registry beside it, in German, with its own boundary stated - no legal advice in an individual case.
    • Sentinelle Creances MCP - The Creditor Claim Deadline - keyless Streamable HTTP at https://creances.amacunia.fr/mcp, server Sentinelle creances FR 1.30.0, 2 tools, registry io.github.Marcoco27/sentinelle-creances, submission #6956. Driven live. creances_example returned SIREN 910759158, a liquidation judiciaire opened by judgment on 2026-10-29, published in the BODACC on 2026-11-08, with date_limite_declaration 2027-01-08, 60 days remaining, the forclusion register closing 2027-05-08, the liquidator named from the judgment text and the bodacc.fr notice linked. creances_lookup then returned an x402 version 2 payment requirement instead of an error: 0.01 USDC on Base, no account, no key, maxTimeoutSeconds 300, with the legal rule in the resource description - two months from publication, four from abroad, article R622-24 of the code de commerce, one to fifty SIREN or SIRET per call. This is the first entry here where a business fact costs a cent and pays through a wallet, and the honest limitation is that a finance team without one cannot use it. French company data already has owners - OpenBase serves 20.5M entities with BODACC proceedings - and what neither it nor Corporary does is the procedure: which judgment opened a window, which publication starts the clock, what the last day is, and when the claim is struck. The sibling catnat.amacunia.fr applies the same instrument to natural-disaster decrees and the 30-day insurance window, recorded in the guide rather than as a seventh entry.
    • DSers MCP - The Dropshipping Loop Behind a Chat - remote Streamable HTTP at https://ai.dsers.com/mcp/mcp-so, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE only, no API keys, from the vendor itself. A keyless initialize answers 401 with invalid_request, an MCP protocol version of 2025-11-25 that is newer than most of this catalogue, a correlation id for support, and both metadata documents published. Those documents are the product brief: 23 scopes that describe the loop exactly - supplier:read to find a supplier product, product:import, product:mapping and product:push to publish it, order:write to place the supplier order, tracking:read to read what comes back, beside store, staff, theme, settings and billing scopes. The class owner is Hustle Got Real with 170 tools over a dropshipping back office behind one broad scope; that is the store's own nervous system, and this is the supplier relationship beside it. Documented rather than driven, no tool list behind the 401, and the standing caution applies: an agent holding product:push and order:write can publish a wrong product and spend real money, so the scopes should be granted by task.
    • Awardlanes MCP - USDA Freight Awards by Territory - remote Streamable HTTP at https://awardlanes.com/mcp, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, DCR and client ID metadata documents, registry com.awardlanes/awardlanes, submission #6969, 5 read-only tools. A keyless initialize returns 401 with a protected-resource pointer and the scope awardlanes. The tools are the broker's day: search_lanes by place, direction, equipment, delivery window, commodity or vendor; get_award by finding id or contract number with every lane and the source; state_summary for territory totals; vendor_awards with published plant contacts; my_account for trial state. Two honest limits are stated by the vendor and both are recorded as strengths: equipment is inferred from the commodity name where USDA does not state it, and outside the territory or after a trial lapses the connector returns the same first 20-lane sample the web page shows with an upgrade link, so a model reading the answer can tell "no lanes" from "not in your plan". Freight already has two neighbours here at other points of the workflow - Plain Freight quotes China to US freight and SpendQuery runs query plans over federal award data - and this is the awarded-lane view a small brokerage bids from.
    • Cotlet MCP - The Apps That Have No API - the architecture of the window, and the reason 19 sitemap slugs became one entry. Remote Streamable HTTP at https://cotlet.dev/mcp/v1 with 719 tools, and at https://cotlet.dev/mcp/v1/<app> per app, where Fresha returns 42; registry records under dev.cotlet. A keyless initialize answers 200 and returns an instruction block that is a safety contract: Cotlet runs the user's own Chrome in the cloud, the user signs in themselves, passwords are never asked for and never typed, and on a sign-in page, a two-factor prompt or a step that needs a person the agent must stop and hand over the browser link. The typed half is a working front desk per app, every integration a _read and _write pair with the operation in operation and its inputs in arguments: Fresha carries list and create appointment, reschedule, cancel, add client, reply to review; Skool carries 30 read and 41 write operations; Tradify 11 and 12. The apps are the ones a service business actually runs and that have no API: salons and spas, cleaning and field service, contractors, photography studios, auto shops, restaurants, property managers, plus CRM, HR and e-signature. Where no typed tool exists, 25 browser tools take over, reading a page as numbered elements. Three governance decisions make it usable: writes that reach other people return pending with a call_id and wait for approval in the Cotlet console, cotlet_whoami, cotlet_apps and cotlet_balance are free so an assistant can report before it spends, and automations are scripted jobs that run with no model and test with every write skipped. Cost is credits and per-minute browser time, the typed coverage is only what Cotlet has written, and the browser path inherits the fragility of every web UI.

    Also identified this evening (not catalogued). supercatch-com-ai answered keylessly with 82 tools, prepare and execute pairs for every write and idempotency keys on every mutation, held on the collectible pricing class where the PokéInvest ruling stands, with the reversal test recorded as a store-operations question rather than a price question; pokeitem/pokeitem-mcp on the same class; oort, memscope-ai, ragionex/memory-mcp, nkoteskey/constellate and nifetency/mcp-excel on memory, workspace and spreadsheet classes; saifuban as an agent spend guard and mishmar-io/mishmar as trading risk control; screenata/screenata-mcp on the compliance programme class carried by ISMS Copilot; voxisim/voxisim-mcp on phone numbers; anyhook/anyhook on developer infrastructure; aurelix-solutions/aurelix-mcp and apinoahq/apinoa-mcp on the Apify-actor hold; findbroadband/mcp, patternswizard-com-open-data, tokenmark-mcp, perigee, microlaunch-mcp, agent-company-mcp, flisk, spcn-usa/specialneeds-cli, liquid-composer, newsjack-cc-mcp, seencxy/solvehub-mcp and jumpermcp/jumper-publisher outside operator scope or on a class this catalogue owns; cloro-dev/mcp-server as the August 12 cloro entry re-listed under a new slug; from the queue, hiveref on hiring verification beside FoundRole, nod as a local approval primitive beside DutyKit, otdeck and kafdesk as desktop-bundled local servers, annsa on project management, boterly, gameye, memorybrain, yandex-tracker-mcp-lite, virtnumber, fwrd-sms-mcp, agent-vscreen, favicondl, qsignals, saascustomdomains, clockintoday on the jobs class and pokeitem on retail; and the 47 documentation-route slugs plus the BumiAtlas, MambaLabs, x402-worker and MCPKit-RU families as listed in the sweep report.

    🆕 November 8, 2026 - Midday Supplement (2 New, 2 Guides)¶

    Fired on the 11:00 MST tick, one hour after the midday pass. The canonical came back set identical and the mcp.so homepage carried no card above the previous stamp, so the whole window is two submissions filed inside that hour. Both are catalogued, and the first is catalogued for the direction of its delegation rather than its category.

    • Marsell MCP - The AI Marketer That Hires Your Agent - remote Streamable HTTP at https://getmarsell.com/mcp, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE or a Bearer mk_ agent key, registry record com.getmarsell/marsell active since 2026-11-04T00:08:52Z. A keyless initialize answers 200 as marsell 1.0.0 on protocol 2025-06-18 and returns an instruction block that reads as an operating manual; tools/list returns all 126 tools with schemas and annotations; tools/call returns the documented 401 naming the agent key. The finding is the direction of the delegation. Every other marketing entry in this catalogue is a tool the assistant calls; Marsell is a client that calls the assistant back. homework_list queues the jobs the platform cannot do because they need the owner's own logins, files or inbox, and homework_done is verified by the platform itself for jobs it can confirm. missions_next returns one message at a time to be sent word for word from the owner's own signed-in browser, and a refused mission is recorded rather than reworded. get_brand holds what the business is while owner_fact_set writes the owner's corrections, which every plan, post and page reads first. Money is quoted before it is spent: picture_price, series_quote, business_read_quote and get_tokens all price the work ahead of the render, and the server tells the assistant to say what it costs. The setup is a scripted conversation (get_setup, fill_setup, set_offer, set_preferences, finish_setup) that refuses to close until the owner's goal, one number and one date are recorded; connecting the accounts and pressing Start are reserved to the owner by instruction. Plans run $49 a month for 200,000 tokens to $799 for 3,600,000, annual at ten times monthly, extra tokens from $1.80 down to $1.50 per 10,000, with ad spend and creator fees separate. Documented rather than driven, and the backend is private, both recorded as limits. The class it enters is crowded (Toffu on ads, Maeve Social on publishing, CampaignStack on outreach, Layers Growth on one channel) and none of them dispatches work back to the user's own agent.
    • Worth Leaving MCP - Walk-Away Math for Unvested Equity - keyless Streamable HTTP at https://worthleaving.com/api/mcp, no account, per-IP rate limit, no inputs stored, registry record com.worthleaving/verdict 1.1.0 published 2026-11-08T17:38:20Z, four minutes before the submission was filed. initialize 200 as worth-leaving 1.1.0; one tool, compute_walk_away_verdict, read-only and idempotent. The instruction is the entry: never compute vest dates or dollar totals yourself. Driven live with a two-grant scenario it returned take-it at 77/100, a walk-away cost of $62,500, an offer threshold of $230,000 a year before tax, an annual net gain of $28,965 and a next vest on 2027-02-01 worth $12,500, then sixteen numbered assumptions, including that the leave date sent was in the past and that the comparison was money-only because no ratings were supplied. Three separable answers rather than one feeling: walkAwayCost, nextVest and offerHasToBeat, with verdict null when no offer is given. Share links carry rounded bands rather than figures. US metros only, engine closed, one document per call, all recorded.

    Integration with CorpusIQ¶

    CorpusIQ is the connector layer that lets AI assistants read the systems a business already runs on - accounting, payments, CRM, email, files and analytics - and answer with the source named. It is read-only by design: it retrieves data and never writes to, or acts in, a connected system, which is what makes it safe to point at live accounts.

    This page is part of the CorpusIQ directory, the reference we maintain for the MCP server and agent-skill ecosystem. Run alongside CorpusIQ, a third-party server like this one can be combined with a company's own business data in a single answer.
